installation_binding: local_inventory_observation; not an official supported-version signature

accepted_evidence: exact canonical Article identity in a curated classed catalog
exact installed package ownership only when every owner has a reviewed container class
exact package override in the revision-bound rules file
classification_methodology.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN is classification metadata only; runtime eligibility is decided by source-package presence. Audit statuses describe unresolved evidence or package absence and do not block an existing supported source.

unknown_status_legend.EXHAUSTIVE_UNRESOLVED: Exact catalog identity and installed package/container ownership were checked, but no reviewed class evidence resolves the class.
unknown_status_legend.NOT_IN_INSTALLED_INVENTORY: The exact package and unique numbered-package resolution are absent from this installation inventory.
